title: IBPS SO IT Officer Mains 2024 Quiz
description: Memory-based questions from IBPS SO IT Officer Mains held on 14 December 2024.

questions.question: A packet of size L bits is transmitted from a source to a destination through N intermediate routers using store-and-forward packet switching. Each link has a transmission rate of R bits per second. Ignoring propagation, processing, and queuing delays, what is the total transmission delay?
Which of the following operations are valid on pointers in C++?
options: Pointer addition and pointer subtraction with integers
questions.answer: Pointer addition and pointer subtraction with integers

questions.question: What is the time complexity of the classical Dynamic Programming approach using nested loops for the LIS problem?
Which file mode in Python is primarily used to append new content to an existing file without deleting the previous data?
In C++, which of the following correctly describes the purpose of endl and setw?
options: endl formats output width, while setw inserts a new line
endl inserts a new line, while setw sets the output field width
endl reads input data, while setw displays output
endl allocates memory, while setw controls loops
endl performs type conversion, while setw handles exceptions
questions.answer: endl inserts a new line, while setw sets the output field width

Which of the following statements correctly distinguishes Composition from Aggregation in Object - Oriented Programming (OOP)?
options: Aggregation represents stronger dependency than Composition
In Composition, the child object depends on the lifecycle of the parent object

questions.question: What is the primary use of a global variable in C++?
options: To store values that can be accessed only inside a loop
To create variables that exist only during function execution
To allow data to be accessed from multiple functions in a program
To permanently store data inside a file
To declare variables that cannot be modified
questions.answer: To allow data to be accessed from multiple functions in a program

Which of the following SQL queries correctly selects records where the First_Name contains a specific pattern, the Last_Name also matches a pattern using LIKE, and the City does not match a given pattern using NOT LIKE?
options: SELECT * FROM Employee WHERE First_Name LIKE '%A%' AND Last_Name LIKE '%K%' AND City NOT LIKE '%Delhi%';
SELECT * FROM Employee WHERE First_Name = '%A%' AND Last_Name = '%K%' AND City != '%Delhi%';
SELECT * FROM Employee WHERE First_Name IN '%A%' AND Last_Name IN '%K%' AND City NOT IN '%Delhi%';
SELECT * FROM Employee WHERE First_Name LIKE '%A%' OR Last_Name LIKE '%K%' OR City NOT LIKE '%Delhi%';
SELECT * FROM Employee WHERE First_Name NOT LIKE '%A%' AND Last_Name LIKE '%K%' AND City LIKE '%Delhi%';
questions.answer: SELECT * FROM Employee WHERE First_Name LIKE '%A%' AND Last_Name LIKE '%K%' AND City NOT LIKE '%Delhi%';

questions.question: Which networking mechanism translates private internal IP addresses into public IP addresses, allowing devices on a local network to communicate with external networks while concealing internal addressing?
What is the primary function of the ARP in an IPv4 local network?
options: To resolve domain names into IP addresses
To determine the MAC address corresponding to an IP address
To forward packets between different networks
questions.answer: To determine the MAC address corresponding to an IP address

Total memory occupied by the hash table

questions.answer: Ratio of stored elements to the total number of slots

questions.question: Which of the following is commonly used to block or allow network ports such as HTTP and SSH?
Which of the following correctly describes a feature of IMAP in email communication systems?
options: Emails are automatically deleted from the server after downloading
Using IMAP , users can manage server-side mailbox properties such as read status and folders.
Emails can be transferred only within local networks
Emails are accessible only in offline mode

questions.question: Which networking device commonly supports traffic monitoring features such as port mirroring, enabling packet analyzers operating in promiscuous mode to inspect network traffic?
In MySQL, which of the following statements correctly creates a trigger that executes automatically before inserting a row into the Employee table?
options: CREATE TRIGGER trg_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON Employee FOR EACH ROW SET @x = 1;
CREATE TABLE trg_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON Employee;
TRIGGER trg_before_insert ON Employee BEFORE INSERT;
CREATE VIEW trg_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON Employee;
questions.answer: CREATE TRIGGER trg_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON Employee FOR EACH ROW SET @x = 1;

questions.question: What is the name of the cyber attack in which an attacker overwhelms a web server by sending a very large number of HTTP requests?
When a foreign key constraint is enforced in a relational database, which condition must normally be satisfied while inserting a non-NULL value into the foreign key column?
options: The value can be inserted without checking the referenced table.
The value must match an existing value in the referenced primary key or unique key column.
A new primary key value is automatically generated in the parent table.
The foreign key checks only uniqueness of the inserted value.
The foreign key column must always contain NULL values.
questions.answer: The value must match an existing value in the referenced primary key or unique key column.

To permanently remove duplicate rows from a table

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of memoization in Dynamic Programming?

questions.question: In MySQL, which query correctly returns the salary appearing in the nth row after sorting all salaries in descending order from the Employees table?
options: SELECT SALARY FROM Employees ORDER BY SALARY DESC LIMIT n, 1;
SELECT SALARY FROM Employees ORDER BY SALARY ASC LIMIT n-1, 1;
SELECT SALARY FROM Employees ORDER BY SALARY DESC LIMIT 1, n-1;
SELECT SALARY FROM Employees ORDER BY SALARY DESC LIMIT n-1, 1;
SELECT MAX(SALARY) FROM Employees WHERE SALARY < n;
questions.answer: SELECT SALARY FROM Employees ORDER BY SALARY DESC LIMIT n-1, 1;

In SQL implementations that support the INSTR() function, what is the default starting index for the first character, and what value is returned if the specified substring is not found in the target string?
options: Starts from 1; returns NULL if not found
Starts from 0; returns -1 if not found
Starts from 1; returns -1 if not found
Starts from 0; returns 0 if not found

What will be the final values of X and Y?

Consider the relation R(Roll_No, Student_ID, Course_ID) with the following functional dependencies:
(Roll_No, Course_ID) → Student_ID
(Student_ID, Course_ID) → Roll_No
Student_ID → Roll_No
The above dependencies completely describe all functional dependencies of the relation. Identify the highest normal form satisfied by the relation.

In most standard SQL implementations, which of the following statements regarding DROP and TRUNCATE commands is incorrect?
options: DROP removes both the table structure and table data.
TRUNCATE removes all rows while preserving the table structure.
TRUNCATE is generally faster than DELETE for removing all rows from a table.
TRUNCATE can always be reversed using ROLLBACK regardless of the DBMS implementation.
DROP removes associated indexes and constraints along with the table.
questions.answer: TRUNCATE can always be reversed using ROLLBACK regardless of the DBMS implementation.
